name: Claw Machine Arcade!
desc:
🎁✨Welcome to Claw Machine Arcade!✨🎁

Claw Machine Arcade is a game center where you can play a number of different realistic arcade games, including claw machines, and win prizes!

The games in this arcade are similar to those you may find in Japanese game centers, Round1 arcades, and more!

- Enter the Arcade and Play Over 60 Realistic Prize Catcher Claw Machines, Star Catcher Machines (UFO Catchers), and more! 🕹️
- Earn Tokens and Win Prizes!
- Unlock New Zones and New Games! 🔓
- Win and Open Blind Boxes! Claw Machine Arcade's blind boxes are inspired by those from popular franchises! 🏬

Thank you for playing! Don't forget to like the game! 👍

Want to report a bug or make a game suggestion? Join the High Tech Games Roblox Group!

⚠️Warning! If you are caught using exploits in-game, you risk being permanently banned!⚠️
